title: API container cannot connect to Compose Postgres via localhost
symptoms: DB works from host browser tools
cause: localhost inside a container refers to that container, not the sibling Compose service or the host.
solution: Use the Compose service name as hostname (e.g. db) on the shared network, matching the service’s internal port. Publish host ports only for host-side clients.
workaround: host.docker.internal on Docker Desktop when intentionally targeting a host-run database.
